qt: to the Commission Stephen Nikola Bartulica (ECR) Subject:

Traditional fishing skills and customs are officially protected as an intangible cultural asset in Croatia. Traditional fishing is part of the cultural heritage and identity of coastal and island communities, and integral to the centuries-old Adriatic way of life. The protected cultural asset encompasses traditional knowledge, fishing skills and the use of traditional fishing equipment and techniques. What is the Commission’s stance, and is it considering introducing a traditional fishing category within the common fisheries policy, in order to safeguard the identity of coastal and island communities?
